These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0007] Refunds above 500.00 need approved_by: Per finance policy FIN-2026-03, support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 require a second approver: accept keyword-only `approved_by=None` and raise `BillingError("approval_required")` when the amount exceeds the threshold and no approver is given. Amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source FIN-2026-03; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
  WARNING: learned on version 1.0.0, this checkout is 2.0.0. Check CHANGELOG.md before relying on it.
- [at-0006] Money operations take keyword-only idempotency_key: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before state validation: if `ledgerly.audit.events()` already has an entry with that key, return the original record without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` call.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source INC-204; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
  WARNING: learned on version 1.0.0, this checkout is 2.0.0. Check CHANGELOG.md before relying on it.
- [at-0009] Raise BillingError with snake_case codes: Signal invalid input by raising `ledgerly.errors.BillingError` with a short snake_case code (e.g. "invalid_rate", "non_positive_amount") and the offending value as the message.
  (learned from task S02 on ledgerly 2.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0002] Normalize money via to_money and round_money: Convert any monetary input with `to_money` from `ledgerly.money` and store it rounded with `round_money`; compare against `ZERO` rather than a literal Decimal.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 4x, 3 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary Decimal results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 5x, 4 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0008] Record state changes via audit.record: Every payment state transition must be logged with `ledgerly.audit.record` using a snake_case event name and the payment id and amount.
  (learned from task E06 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
  WARNING: learned on version 1.0.0, this checkout is 2.0.0. Check CHANGELOG.md before relying on it.

item.title: Round money with round_money, never floats
item.content: Convert and round all monetary amounts via ledgerly.money.to_money and round_money (banker's rounding per FIN-2026-07); to_money rejects floats with BillingError("float_amount").

item.title: Follow payments.authorize pattern for money moves
item.content: Money-moving functions should mirror ledgerly.payments.authorize: round via round_money, reject amount <= ZERO with BillingError("non_positive_amount"), require invoice.status == "issued" with BillingError("invalid_state"), and record via audit.record.
